en.t: My whole world was turned upside down.

units.source_text: 然而，对我来说，并不是第一次有这样的体验。

en.t: And yet, for me, this was not the first time I had experienced such a thing.

units.source_text: 大约在我十六七岁时吧，我初次发现人间竟然有那么美的东西的时候，曾经惊讶万分过。

en.t: When I was about sixteen or seventeen, the first time I discovered that such beautiful things existed in the world, I was once utterly astonished.

units.source_text: 我不知怀疑过自己的眼睛多少次，不知把眼睛擦了多少次，

en.t: I do not know how many times I doubted my own eyes, or how many times I rubbed them,

units.source_text: 我在心中呼喊：啊，太美了！

en.t: I cried out in my heart: ah, how beautiful!

units.source_text: 说到十六七岁的年纪，无论男女都是人们说的情窦初开的时候。

en.t: At sixteen or seventeen, whether boy or girl, one is at what people call the age when love first awakens.

units.source_text: 春情萌动的我，开始把女人看作人间美的代表了，

en.t: With my young feelings of love beginning to stir, I began to see women as the representatives of beauty in the world,

units.source_text: 我那从不曾注意过异性存在的盲人般的眼睛，突然对她们洞开了。

en.t: My blind eyes, which had never noticed the existence of the opposite sex, suddenly opened wide to them.

units.source_text: 从那以后，我的天地焕然一新了。

en.t: From then on, my world became completely new.

units.source_text: 发觉叔叔的变化时，我的心情也与此相同，是突然觉悟的。

en.t: When I noticed the change in my uncle, my state of mind was the same; it was a sudden awakening.

units.source_text: 没有任何预感或精神准备，是突如其来的。

en.t: There was no premonition or mental preparation; it came all at once.

units.source_text: 在我的眼里，叔叔和他的家人骤然间变得完全陌生了。

en.t: In my eyes, my uncle and his family suddenly became complete strangers.

units.source_text: 异常震惊的我开始担心，倘若照这样子下去，自己今后的日子可怎么办。

en.t: Deeply shaken, I began to worry what would become of me in the days ahead if things went on like this.
